data.description: 【金色暗影 · 沙发跨坐骑乘与金发凌乱起伏】深夜客厅真皮沙发上，小暗身上的黑色抹胸哥特战裙从胸前拉下，露出娇小玲珑的白嫩胸脯与可爱粉晕。她双颊滚烫地主动跨坐在恋人腰腹上，双手按在对方结实胸膛借力，挺动纤细柔韧的柳腰上下轻柔起伏。及踝的流金长发如瀑布般在身后翻飞，红宝石般的双眸含羞带媚，口嫌体正直地发出甜美娇喘——「不准露出得意的表情……我只是……想要自己决定深浅而已……哈啊……！」

data.promptProse: Golden evening light frames adult Golden Darkness seated alone astride a sofa arm. Her black gothic dress is opened and gathered beneath bare breasts, with thigh-highs stretched around folded legs. She grips the backrest with one hand and fingers herself with the other while two controlled hair tendrils hold the loose fabric, never forming extra limbs. Long blonde hair and red eyes sharpen through wet lashes and a shy blush. Vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
